about: Verbs that place a learning objective at a level of the revised Bloom's taxonomy (Anderson and Krathwohl, 2001). A verb is listed only where common published lists agree on its level. Matching takes the highest level found, so a verb admitted at the wrong level outranks every correct verb below it; when in doubt, a verb is excluded rather than guessed.

excluded.compare: placed at Understand, Analyze and Evaluate by different published lists
excluded.check: an everyday instruction ('check your work') far more often than Evaluate's 'checking'
excluded.select: placed at Remember, Apply and Evaluate by different lists
excluded.choose: placed at Remember, Apply and Evaluate by different lists
excluded.write: covers everything from writing down a term (Remember) to writing an essay (Create)
excluded.build: placed at Apply and Create by different lists
excluded.map: in a geography course a map is a product, not a cognitive level
excluded.identify: placed at Remember and Analyze by different lists
excluded.classify: placed at Understand and Analyze by different lists
excluded.review: placed at Understand and Evaluate by different lists
excluded.test: placed at Apply and Evaluate by different lists
excluded.outline: placed at Understand, Analyze and Create by different lists
excluded.illustrate: placed at Understand and Apply by different lists
excluded.produce: placed at Apply and Create by different lists
